correctness.rationale: TARGET route: headline Gap claim inf_{s in [3/8,5/8]} P(s) >= 11 with min 11 at s=1/2 independently re-verified. Vertices: s<=5/8<1 makes +-e_i uniquely maximized by +-x_i; 4s>=3/2>1 makes +-s*z uniquely maximized by +-sum x_i, so genuine 10-vertex body. Polar R_s^circ = cube [-1,1]^4 intersect {|sum|<=1/s} exact by hull-of-points duality. Primal V(s)=(4s+7)/12 (s<=1/2), s+1/4 (s>=1/2): base facet vol 1/3 via regular-tetrahedron/Gram det 4, heights (4s-1)/2 and (2s-1)/2, visibility 4-2k>t with t=1/s in [8/5,8/3] gives 1 facet per apex for s<=1/2 and 5 for s>1/2; opposite pyramids disjoint so doubling is additive; continuity V(1/2)=3/4. Dual V*(s)=16-(4-t)^4/12 (t in [2,8/3]) via simplex (4-a)^4/24 for a>=3, and t(3t^3-16t^2+128)/12 (t in [8/5,2]) via Irwin-Hall two-level inclusion-exclusion; verified endpoints P(3/8)=8126/729, P(1/2)=11, P(5/8)=21728/1875 by exact Fractions replay (verify_gap.py VERIFY_OK plus independent recomputation). Gap: Piece A reduces to H(u)=7u^5-32u^4+240u-192>=0 on [4/3,2] with H''=28u^2(5u-96/7)<0, H(4/3)=13696/243>0, H(2)=0; Piece B to S(t)=3t^4-4t^3-64t^2+128t-16>=0 on [8/5,2] with S'' increasing and <=-32<0, S(8/5)=17648/625>0, S(2)=0; strict concavity + chord bound gives P>=11 with equality only at s=1/2. Margin 11-808/75=17/75 exact. One presentation slip: Piece A equivalence printed as (7t+4)(192-(4-t)^4)>=1584 omits factor t on RHS; correct form >=1584t is what H(u) encodes and what was proved, so headline proof is intact. Steiner observation (swap x1<->x2 fixes R_s, equality case) is true but vacuous; deficit D>=1/3 follows from exact product bound, honestly disclosed as not a general stability modulus. Monte Carlo is labeled sanity only.
